# Swagger UI 5.34.0

Official `swagger-ui-dist` assets, served locally so `/api/docs` respects POSTURE's content security policy and works without external connections.

Pinned sources:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swagger-ui-dist@5.34.0/swagger-ui.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swagger-ui-dist@5.34.0/swagger-ui-bundle.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swagger-ui-dist@5.34.0/LICENSE

Project: https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui

Licence: Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE`. When updating, replace both assets from the same version and verify the documentation with external connections blocked.
